title: When the Cellar Wakes
author: Vesper Thackeray
blurb: Kestrel Montrose, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
